name: an alias made on a line works from the next line
lines: printf '%s\n' "alias one='echo one'" one "alias two='echo two'; two" > a.sh

up"

lines: mkdir v; touch f; chmod u+x-r v; ls -ld v
chmod u=gx f; chmod u+ug f; chmod u+x, f; chmod u f; echo s$?

name: several files with a missing one between
lines: echo A > a; printf B > b; mkdir d
cat a nope b; echo s$?

head a nope d b; echo s$?
wc a nope d b; echo s$?
grep . a nope d b; echo s$?
grep -s . a nope b; echo s$?
